email.subject: One agent for every support channel
email.preview_text: Chat, email, and phone conversations handled together
email.body:
Support leaders rarely get to choose one clean channel. Customers move between an inbox, a chat window, and a phone call while the team tries to keep context intact.

RelayDesk drafts text replies for web chat and email from approved knowledge articles. It also handles inbound voice calls and answers customers on the phone without an agent joining.

That means one queue, one policy, and one place to review every conversation. Supervisors can spend their time on exceptions instead of watching work bounce between channel-specific tools.

Put a recent support question through the workflow and compare the answer with what an experienced agent would send.
